modules.name: app-entry
modules.responsibility: Mounts either the app shell or the styleguide from a single Vite SPA entry, owns the TriggerLab engine store, shell store, global keyboard shortcuts, and the desktop-bridge/boot lifecycle.
modules.notes: Scope named `apps/web/src/lib/ui/.../routes` but there is NO SvelteKit routes dir — routing is the `?style` query switch in main.ts plus shell-nav in lib/app (out of my scope). App.svelte holds real keyboard-dispatch logic inline alongside a registry-based shortcut seam.

modules.name: ws-client
modules.responsibility: Owns the browser end of the engine WebSocket: dialling with pin/hostToken, reconnect with exponential backoff, binary-vs-text frame demux, and fan-out of typed server messages to a callback bag.
public_interface: WSClient (connect, close, send, on, reconnectWithPin, hasAuthError, reconnectAttempt)
modules.notes: Reconnect/auth-pause/frame-decoding behaviour behind a small class; WSFactory makes it test-hermetic.

modules.name: ws-protocol-decode
modules.responsibility: Re-exports the shared @ledrums/protocol wire types for web import paths and adds the runtime zod decode of inbound text frames with a dev-only malformed-frame warning.
modules.notes: Mostly a re-export barrel; the only real behaviour is decodeServer's silent-drop contract.

modules.name: webmidi-capture
modules.responsibility: Requests WebMIDI access, enumerates and hot-plug-tracks input ports, and parses raw MIDI bytes into a note/cc/programChange discriminated union for forwarding to the engine.
modules.notes: Degrades to an available:false result rather than throwing; structural nav type keeps it node-testable.

modules.name: midi-note-format
modules.responsibility: Pure conversions between MIDI note numbers and note names, plus the channel dropdown option list used by MIDI-filter UI.

modules.name: visualizer-3d
modules.responsibility: Renders the LED kit as a Threlte/three.js scene, building a curved per-pixel tube mesh from the serialized model geometry and rewriting vertex colours from each incoming RGB frame.
modules.notes: Pixels.svelte is the densest file in scope: hand-rolled BufferGeometry (12 verts / 48 indices per pixel), heuristic hoop-boundary detection via AXIAL_K / HOOP_GAP_K constants, cold-build vs hot colour-only path.

modules.name: visualizer-2d
modules.responsibility: Draws a flat diagnostic canvas strip of the live frame, one row per drum, sized by a ResizeObserver on its wrapper.

modules.name: visualizer-shared-color
modules.responsibility: Single source of truth for the unlit-pixel colour in both normalized-float and 8-bit forms so the 3D and 2D views cannot drift.

modules.name: ui-form-controls
modules.responsibility: The project's styled input primitives — numeric slider with inline editable readout, commit-on-enter/blur text and number fields, select, boolean controls, search, easing and colour pickers.
modules.notes: Slider and CommitInput are genuinely deep (normalize/step/precision, commit-decision rules extracted to a pure module and unit-tested); Switch, Toggle, SegmentedControl, Separator, Tooltip are thin bits-ui wrappers.

modules.name: ui-layout-shell
modules.responsibility: Layout scaffolding primitives: a controlled drag/keyboard splitter, the master-detail rail+pane grid, and the panel/section header treatments.
public_interface: <Splitter orientation size onResize invert min max step label style>
modules.notes: Splitter is deliberately controlled — it never persists; callers own the size. MasterDetail is generic over T and pure layout.

modules.name: ui-overlays
modules.responsibility: Modal, drawer, confirm and context-menu surfaces layered on bits-ui Dialog/ContextMenu/Tooltip with project chrome and layering.
modules.notes: Dialog and Drawer both wrap bits-ui Dialog with near-identical prop shapes.

modules.name: ui-status-display
modules.responsibility: Read-mostly display primitives: tonal dots/pills, live input-activity badge, lint callout, copy-to-clipboard value, list rows with inline rename and context menu, icon buttons and the logo mark.

modules.name: ui-toast
modules.responsibility: A singleton rune-based transient-notification store plus the single host component that renders the stack with reduced-motion-aware transitions.
modules.notes: Store is DOM-free and node-testable; host owns rendering only. Module-level singleton with module-level `seq` counter.

modules.name: ui-theme-tokens
modules.responsibility: The one sanctioned way for canvas-drawing components to sample CSS custom-property colours, with fixed non-reactive fallbacks that make a known effect-cycle bug unwritable.
modules.notes: Exists specifically as a guard against a previously app-fatal effect_update_depth_exceeded pattern.

modules.name: styleguide-shell
modules.responsibility: The living-styleguide page frame: table of contents, demo-card chrome, click-to-copy chips and token swatches, mounted both by the /?style dev route and the single-file design-system artifact build.

modules.name: styleguide-sections
modules.responsibility: Per-topic demo pages that instantiate the REAL lib/ui, lib/app and lib/trigger-lab components against local stub state, so the styleguide references rather than duplicates the shipped components.
public_interface: each section is a prop-less component rendered by Styleguide.svelte
modules.notes: Confirmed reference-not-duplicate for components: demos import the real thing. BUT the sections reach deep into private-looking app internals (app/docks/inspectors/*, trigger-lab/sim, trigger-lab/fixtures, app/boot-reducer) and SectionGraph carries long prose descriptions of graph interaction that are hand-maintained, not generated.

modules.name: styleguide-introspection
modules.responsibility: Resolves design-system metadata at runtime: repo-relative source paths from a build-time virtual manifest, and authored+browser-resolved colour values for each token via a canvas round-trip.
modules.notes: Small interface, real machinery behind it; a stale manifest key surfaces as a visible ⚠ chip rather than a silent wrong path.

seams.why: The socket constructor is a prop, so transport can be swapped for a fake without touching client code; client.test.ts already uses it.
WebMIDI access is injectable, so device enumeration and parsing are testable with no hardware.
All inbound validation funnels through one function; changing wire-tolerance policy is a single-site edit.
Commit/cancel/revert policy is a pure function separated from the component's DOM wiring; new field semantics land here, not in markup.
A deliberate seam that makes the canvas token-read idiom uniform and makes the self-referential-effect bug unwritable.
Source pointers resolve through a build-time generated manifest, so renames surface as visible misses instead of being hand-maintained.
Only mod+z and mod+d go through the registry; digits, arrows, Backspace/Delete and the typing-target guard are still hand-branched below it, so 'add a shortcut' has two different answers.
The app's only routing decision is an inline URLSearchParams branch in the entry file; there is no route table, so adding a second non-app surface means editing the bootstrap.
Every consumer deep-imports individual .svelte paths, so the primitive set has no declared public surface and no place to deprecate or rename through.

Ring segmentation is inferred from geometry with tuned constants inside a Svelte component; there is no injectable/pure boundary function, so it cannot be unit-tested or swapped for real hoop metadata.
pushToast writes to a module global with a module-level id counter; there is no provider/context seam, so tests and any second host share one instance.
Every new server message type requires editing three places (protocol type, callback field, dispatch switch); the seam exists but does not absorb change.

suspicions.hunch: A 14-arm switch that mechanically mirrors the message union, plus an optional-callback field per arm; adding a message means three coordinated edits and a missed arm fails silently.

onState takes project, model, effects, projects, output, showLibrary, songLibrary, tunnel, osc positionally; a reordering or an added field is easy to mis-wire and impossible for the type system to catch across same-typed nullable slots.
Three components wrap the same bits-ui Dialog with overlapping open/onClose/title/class props and likely duplicated overlay/layer/escape chrome.
Three boolean/enum controls with near-identical prop shapes and bits-ui wrapping; the differences may be purely visual and collapsible into one control with a variant.
The tuple {onChange, disabled, ariaLabel, class} recurs in roughly a dozen primitives with no shared base type, so a change to the control contract has to be applied by hand everywhere.

The root keyboard handler mixes a shortcut registry with inline branches for digits, arrows, delete and typing-target detection, and reaches into store.selectedGraph/activeSong — it will change for both shell reasons and domain reasons.

Styleguide sections import from app/docks/inspectors/*, app/boot-reducer, trigger-lab/sim and trigger-lab/fixtures — the design system depends on app-internal modules, so refactoring an inspector breaks the styleguide build.
A 271-line primitive that reverse-engineers a unit string out of the formatted display; formatting policy probably belongs to the caller's `format` prop rather than being inferred.
Malformed frames, Blob arrayBuffer rejections, and send() failures are all swallowed with no user-visible signal outside DEV; a version-skewed server would present as a silently frozen UI.
Backoff caps at 8s and retries forever with no jitter and no surfaced 'giving up' state; many tabs reconnecting to a restarted engine would sync-thunder.
Uses deprecated document.execCommand('copy') with DOM scratch nodes; CopyableValue.svelte likely has its own separate copy implementation, so there are two clipboard policies.
Two-thirds of the module is a pure re-export barrel over @ledrums/protocol kept only for legacy web import paths; only decodeServer earns its place.
Both walk model.drums / pixelStart against the same flat RGB frame buffer with their own indexing arithmetic; only the dark-pixel constant is actually shared.
A test-only fixture living in the shipped primitives directory, and a Logo primitive whose only consumer may be the styleguide — both may be unreachable from the app bundle.

items.coverage_notes: The stated scope path `apps/web/src/lib/routes` (and any SvelteKit routes dir) DOES NOT EXIST — apps/web is a plain Vite SPA whose entry is main.ts with a `?style` query switch. I substituted the three entry files (main.ts, design-system.ts, App.svelte) so the mount/route surface is still mapped; lib/app, lib/trigger-lab and src/styles were treated as out of scope and only observed through imports. Read in full or in substantial part: main.ts, design-system.ts, App.svelte, ws/client.ts, ws/protocol-types.ts, midi/webmidi.ts, midi/midi-note.ts, visualizer/dark-pixel.ts, visualizer/Pixels2D.svelte (script), visualizer/Scene.svelte (script), styleguide/Styleguide.svelte, CopyChip, DemoCard, source-pointer, resolve-color, README, ui/theme-tokens, ui/toast.svelte.ts, ui/ToastHost, ui/commit-input.ts, ui/Slider (script), Splitter, MasterDetail, Toggle, Switch, TextField. NOT read: the bodies of Pixels.svelte (rtk's reader elided the function bodies — the geometry-build and hot colour path are described from comments and structure only, so my depth call there is inferential), all eight Section*.svelte files (mapped from their import lists and size, not their content — the duplication verdict "references real components" is confirmed by imports but I did not check every demo for inlined markup), and roughly 20 smaller lib/ui components mapped only from their Props signatures. All CSS blocks in every .svelte file are unread, so styling duplication across primitives is unassessed. No test file contents were reviewed beyond noting which modules have tests.
